paragraphs: Campspot sells campground management and reservation software to park owners and operators. It also runs a consumer booking site where campers search campgrounds, RV parks, cabins, and glamping stays.

On the operations side the software reaches from the front desk to housekeeping. Dashboards and reports track a park's health metrics. The platform connects to dozens of third-party applications. Software customers can show real-time availability on the consumer site for guests to search, discover, and book. Listing on that marketplace is not sold separately from the software.

Campspot serves more than 3,500 parks across the U.S. and Canada, including private RV parks and campgrounds, public parks, franchises, multi-park groups, and investment groups. The company was founded in 2015 to bring a modern booking experience to the camping industry. The marketplace itself launched in the winter of 2020. Campspot is headquartered in Grand Rapids, Michigan.
